text:
SUMMARY OF CAPITAL OUTLAY APPROPRIATIONS (Capital Outlay Bill and Other Bills with Capital Appropriations) 1/

1/ This table summarizes all capital appropriations for FY 2026. Please refer to the agency sections for any changes to capital appropriations in FY 2025 and earlier. Appropriations are listed by the state's "building systems." Capital Outlays are budgeted on an annual basis except under special circumstances.

2/ Laws 2024, Chapter 211, Section 10, as amended by Laws 2025, Chapter 235, Section 4 advances appropriates \$30,000,000 in FY 2027 and \$76,000,000 in FY 2028 to widen I-10 from SR 85 to Citrus Road.
